comments.html: Your post made me wonder if I would see the connect state in neighbor table if I could hold the connection at the TCP established state without exchanging BGP messages but no I still could not see connect state. This exists only in the debug messages. Then just for fun I explored how it would transition to other states when it receives BGP messages step by step. I made a blog post about it if you would like to read it: https://forwardingengine.com/post/bgp-fsm-cisco-ios-xe/
